Why there's a Blind Specialist

In 1995 I started this business after a hard time in my life. My divorce left me with two children and no income.

I began by cleaning and repairing blinds. Then I became an agent for top manufacturers and started selling custom-made new blinds.

The business is built on honesty, exceptional service and unbeatable prices, and it truly took off when we launched our website. We are a family enterprise.

Sonja

Who makes them

I'm a top agent for these manufacturers

As an authorised agent for several manufacturers in South Africa, I can send the blinds straight from the factory to any location in the country. Guarantees on the blinds are administered by Blind Specialist. I can send you samples on request.

Straight answer

Why am I cheaper?

Four reasons, no mystery. I keep my costs low and pass it on to you.

1You measure, you save

Take your own measurements and you can have an extra 10% discount, as a reward for the effort.

2No big showroom rent

I don't pay for a physical showroom, so you don't pay for one. Visits are by appointment only.

3Call-out fees when I measure

If you'd like me to take the measurements, there's a call-out fee from R300, refunded when you place your order.

4Do it all from home

Complete your whole order by email or WhatsApp, from your home or office. It saves you money and the trip.

How it works

Quote and order by email or WhatsApp. If you'd rather talk, give me a call.

  1. 1Choose

    Pick the type and colour of blind you like. I can send you samples on request.

  2. 2Measure

    Follow my measuring guide for the extra 10% discount, or ask me to measure for you (call-out from R300, refunded when you order).

  3. 3Send it to me

    Use the form below, WhatsApp or email. I send you a quote, and once you accept it I raise an official order.

  4. 4Deposit & check

    After the deposit is paid I send a measurer to check your measurements, if you're in Durban or the surrounding areas.

  5. 5Delivered & fitted

    Straight to your doorstep, or installed at your home or office. Prefer to fit it yourself? I have guides.

The small print, said out loud

What you can count on, and what it costs

My promises

  • 3-year carry-in guarantee on your blinds.
  • Double quality check on all my blinds.
  • Found a fault? Send me a photo. I'll tell you whether it goes back to the factory or whether we can send a technician to fix it on-site (within 50 km of our offices).
  • Broke something while fitting it yourself? Bring it in. Those repairs are free of charge.
  • Because every blind is custom-made, I can't accept returns.
  • Measuring yourself? You can ask me for Self-measuring Insurance (3% of the total of your blinds). If you don't ask for it, I'm not responsible for measuring mistakes.
honest is the whole idea!

Where it all started

I still clean and repair blinds

Cleaning is where Blind Specialist began, and I still do it for vertical, Venetian and roller blinds in Durban and the surrounding areas. Cleaning can't be done on-site, but some repairs can.

The best way to get a repair quote is to send me a photo on WhatsApp with your details and what's wrong.
